Hi {{1.payload.responses.name.value}},

Thank you for your interest in Wise Eagle Bay - the only winery in the Margaret River Region where rolling vineyards meet pristine ocean views.

Here's what makes couples choose us over every other venue: Everything happens in one stunning location. Your ceremony, reception, and those Instagram-worthy photos all happen in one breathtaking location overlooking Geographe Bay.

But here's the thing - our most sought-after dates book out 12-18 months ahead.

I'd hate for you to miss out on your perfect date.

Ready to chat about your dream wedding?

SPEAK WITH OUR WEDDING TEAM - Click Here

Book a time to speak with our wedding specialists - in person, over the phone, or via video link. We'll discuss your vision and show you exactly why this view exists nowhere else in the region.

Weddings Team
